note: Bank Negara Malaysia's CCRIS questions and answers: a lender updates a record by its next reporting date, no later than the 10th of the following month, a monthly cycle with no threshold, written as 30 days; installments in arrears show for the last 12 months, written as one year.

sources.title: Bank Negara Malaysia, FAQs: CCRIS, other issues with my CCRIS Report
sources.said: The record will be updated by the participating financial institution by the next reporting date, i.e. not later than 10th of the following month.

sources.title: Bank Negara Malaysia, FAQs: CCRIS, questions on my CCRIS Report
sources.said: Nevertheless, the information on number of installments in arrears for the last 12 months will be displayed in the CCRIS Report.
